sections.text_helper: Section 57.7.20 "TIM15 alternate function register 2 (TIM15_AF2)" in chapter 57 (General purpose timers (TIM15/TIM16/TIM17)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 2897.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x064
Reset value: 0x00000000
Bits 31:19 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 18:16 OCRSEL[2:0]: ocref_clr source selection
These bits select the ocref_clr input source.
000: tim_ocref_clr0
001: tim_ocref_clr1
010: tim_ocref_clr2
011: tim_ocref_clr3
100: tim_ocref_clr4
101: tim_ocref_clr5
110: tim_ocref_clr6
111: tim_ocref_clr7
Refer to Section57.4.2: TIM15/TIM16/TIM17 pins and internal signals for product specific
implementation.
Note: These bits can not be modified as long as LOCK level 1 has been programmed (LOCK
bits in TIM15_BDTR register).
Bits 15:0 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
